name: nengliu-flowtwin
description: FlowTwin: EV & fuel trip energy planning, queue forecasting, operator diversion simulation, and optional local OCR demo

scripts.check: node --input-type=module -e "import { readdirSync } from 'node:fs'; import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'; const files = ['app.js', 'service-intent.js', 'server.mjs', ...readdirSync('lib').filter((f) => f.endsWith('.mjs')).map((f) => 'lib/' + f), ...readdirSync('test').filter((f) => f.endsWith('.test.mjs')).map((f) => 'test/' + f)]; for (const file of files) execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', file], { stdio: 'inherit' });"
